description: Simulates the Slack Web API including chat, conversations, users, reactions, pins, files, and more. Every method answers GET and POST, and arguments are accepted as a query string, a form body, multipart, text/plain or JSON, as Slack accepts them. A name that is not a method answers unknown_method before authentication, and every error repeats its code in the x-slack-failure header. The caller is identified from the token, which may be sent in the Authorization header or a form body field: any well-formed xoxb-, xoxp- or xapp- token is accepted, seeded tokens speak for their own user, and auth.revoke revokes. api.test answers without a token.
